_about: SKILL9 (2026-11-11) plan to bring the skills a player meets on main Maps 0-20 under 80. Hand-written; read by tools/skill9/skill9_audit_2026_11_11.py, which counts it. how: display = already an ENG39 kind, only its name changes to 'Family - kind'; kind = becomes a kind of the family and keeps its own rule and price (ENG39's mechanism, decision DES2-3 a); rule = the rule changes too. A family counts once (the Map cards window would count the family key, not the kind). Nothing here is applied.

failures.problem: Uses Stone on Map 8; the owner's rule is no Stone before Map 21 (Malachite Golem's Stone cost on the M8 list is the same problem, card data, not in the owner's picks)
failures.fix: mechanics: Thrive - 3+ Lumber {Armor 1}, or move the card past Map 20

failures.problem: Card text describes the retired SK2 point rule ('+1 scavenge point, every 3: 1 Lumber'); the engine runs EN8's rule (+1 Lumber when another of your units dies, bramblewood-engine.js en8DeathFeed); the Codex text is right
failures.fix: wording: ui.sk2-scavenge to the EN8 rule

failures.problem: Links Pack units, but no card on a main list of Maps 0-20 has Pack: it does nothing on the road
failures.fix: data: drop Pack Leader from Dhole Matriarch (priced 0, so no budget change); Lone Wolf stays

failures.problem: By the list rule Map 1 introduces 13 skills, Maps 3, 6 and 7 nine each (rules 10-21 RP: two new a map; UI35: 2-3). After the plan Maps 1 and 3 still bring 9-10
failures.fix: the plan, then the pacing moves in the doc (card placement, the owner picks)

failures.problem: Priced 0.0 in canonical/skill-costs.json while its own note says 1.0 (half scale, ENG9, not measured)
The same +2/+2 threshold shape costs 1.68 (Carnage, old uptime, call ENG22-5) to 7.95 (Almanac, theoretical)
Most road skills have one carrier on Maps 0-20 (owner's signature target: 2+)
failures.fix: the plan cuts or folds most; CONTENT work for the rest

failures.problem: Its day and night parts are the same (+1/+0 and +1/+0): a flat +1 Attack wearing a time skill
failures.fix: data: a real day / night split, or plain Diurnal or Nocturnal (owner's card; not in the M1 picks)

failures.problem: Dodges only while an enemy Predator is on the field; no card on the M14 list has Predator (the road's Predators are on Maps 6 and 12), so it is rarely on
failures.fix: mechanics: F4 (Evasive - hunted reading the Cull family) or plain Evasive

failures.problem: Text says magic twice ('...but magic (never below 0). Magic goes past it.')
failures.fix: wording: 'Takes N less damage from every swing, arrow and spit (never below 0). Magic goes past it.'

failures.problem: Plurals and grammar on the card: '1 Echoes', '2 1/1 copies', '1x Bramble Sprout take', '+2 Berry', 'every ally that is Ants'
Fork has no full stop and says 'this unit'; Charge says 'a random opponent' (an enemy unit); Spitfire's '1 to an adjacent unit' does not say adjacent to what

'Delivery, every turn' (comma form), 'Foe's Scarcity', 'Iron-will' (hyphen); Cull's key is hunter and project-state still says Hunter N; collisions: Frost / Frostbite / Freeze / Ice, Venomous / Venom Spit / Deadly Poison / Poison Barbs, Brood / Progeny / Offspring / Sprout / Meiosis, Shield / Spellward / Ward
failures.fix: wording: the families' 'Family - kind' names solve most
